newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Repsol to be privatised in April/May.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Repsol to be privatised in April/May.

text.p: The sale of Spain's remaining 10 percent stake in energy group Repsol will take place from mid April to mid May, Spanish Industry Ministry Josep Pique was quoted by Europa Press news agency as saying on Wednesday.

"After Telefonica's success, next is the sale of the remaining 10 percent in Repsol. If market conditions will not change, it could be between the second half of April and the second half of May," Pique told reporters in Barcelona.
Repsol's privatisation is expected to bring into the state's coffers around 160 billion pesetas net at current levels.
The state received a total of 607 billion pesetas for the sale of its 21 percent stake in Telefonica.
